# Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue and
ExecPlan when applicable. List any dependency on another PR.

## Validation

Give the relevant commands and results, including positive/negative examples and
checker inference when the public API changes. Distinguish local validation from
hosted checks, and explain skips or remaining limitations.

## Documentation and compatibility

Identify updated guides, examples and changelog entries, or explain why none are
needed. Note public-contract, dependency or artifact changes. Merge approval is
separate from release or deployment approval.
